newsitem.title: CHINA: China sets up first bank specialising in housing.
newsitem.headline: China sets up first bank specialising in housing.

text.p: China's first bank designed to help people buy their own home will be set up in northern Hebei province later this year, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

The Housing Bank, a specialised bank under the supervision of the People's Bank of China, the central bank, will be charged with pooling funds that enterprises and institutions reserve for the purchase of apartments, it said.
It will also provide loans to individuals and savings services related to home-buying, it said.
The lack of financial services is one of the major factors holding back people from buying homes in China, it said.
At present, there are few housing loans for individuals, and these are short-term and at high interest rates.
It gave no details of what rates the Housing Bank would offer.
